note: Every quote is copied verbatim from the official page named in 'source' and 'section'. Re-read on 2026-11-13 where marked. PF-14 was withdrawn on 2026-11-13: its text was not found in the sections read. Quotes are short; bracketed text is an editorial placeholder in the source. 'applies_to' is the project's reading and is not a quote.

facts.topic: Required disclosure wording
facts.quote: You must clearly and prominently state the following, or any substantially similar statement previously allowed under this Agreement, on your Site or any other location where Amazon may authorize your display or other use of Program Content: “As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.”
facts.applies_to: Shown on every page of this site (footer).

facts.topic: Breach of disclosure rule
facts.quote: For the avoidance of doubt and without limitation for purposes of the foregoing subsection (a) any violation of Section 5 and as specified in the Program Policies will be deemed a material breach of this Agreement.
facts.applies_to: Why the disclosure is treated as mandatory.

facts.topic: Special Links must carry the Associates tag
facts.quote: For example, you must include your Associates ID or “tag” (appearing as XXXXX-##, or such other format as we may designate) as a parameter in the URL of each link you place on your Site to an Amazon Site.
facts.applies_to: No tag has been supplied, so no Special Link has been created (FLG-010).

facts.topic: Prices and availability may be shown only through the link or the API
facts.quote: Product prices and availability may vary from time to time. ... your Site may only show prices and availability if: (a) we serve the link in which that price and availability data are displayed, or (b) you obtain Product pricing and availability data via Creators API or PA API and you comply with the requirements regarding use of Creators API or PA API in the License.
facts.applies_to: Pricing cells are left blank. No price is typed in from a web page (FLG-004, FLG-006).

facts.topic: Customer reviews and star ratings
facts.quote: You will not display or otherwise use any of our customer reviews or star ratings, in part or in whole, on your Site unless you have obtained a link to that customer review or star rating through Creators API or PA API and you comply with the requirements for Creators API and PA API described in the License.
facts.applies_to: Rating and review-count cells are left blank (FLG-004).

facts.topic: Link shorteners must not obscure the Amazon destination
facts.quote: You will not use a link shortening service, button, hyperlink or other ad placement in a manner that makes it unclear that you are linking to an Amazon Site.
facts.applies_to: Applies to the link.amazon short links (FLG-003).

facts.topic: Redirecting Links disqualify purchases
facts.quote: any Product purchased by a customer who is referred to an Amazon Site by a link that sends users indirectly to an Amazon Site via an intermediate site, without requiring the customer to click on a link or take some other affirmative action on that intermediate site (a “Redirecting Link”)
facts.applies_to: If link.amazon redirects without a click, purchases from it may not count (FLG-003).

facts.topic: Cloaking and obscured destinations
facts.quote: You will not cloak, hide, spoof, or otherwise obscure the URL of your Site containing Special Links (including by use of Redirecting Links) or the user agent of the application in which Program Content is displayed or used such that we cannot reasonably determine the site or application from which a customer clicks through such Special Link to an Amazon Site.
facts.section: Program Policies, Associates Program Participation Requirements, Section 6(v)
facts.applies_to: Site must not hide its URL behind redirects.

facts.topic: No offline or printed use of Special Links
facts.quote: You will not engage in any Promotional Activities in any offline manner, including by using any of our or our affiliates’ trademarks or logos (including any Amazon Mark), any Program Content, or any Special Link in connection with any printed material, ebook, mailing, or any oral solicitation.
facts.applies_to: No printed, QR-code or ebook use of these links.

facts.topic: Cookie-cutter or inaccurate product claims
facts.quote: You must not make inaccurate, overbroad, deceptive or otherwise misleading claims about any Product, an Amazon Site, or any of our policies, promotions, or prices.
facts.applies_to: Content cannot state product facts that are not verified (FLG-012).

facts.topic: Comparison price display
facts.quote: if you choose to display prices for any Product on your Site in any “comparison” format (including through the use of any price-comparison tool or engine) together with prices for the same or similar products offered through any web site or other means other than an Amazon Site, you must display both the lowest “new” price and, if we provide it to you, the lowest “used” price at which the Product is available on the Amazon Site.
facts.applies_to: Any future comparison article must follow this rule.

facts.topic: Commission window: 24-hour session and 89-day cart window
facts.quote: during a single session, which is measured as beginning when a customer clicks through that Special Link and ending upon the first to occur of the following: (x) 24 hours elapse from that click, ... (i) the customer purchases a Product by adding a Product to his or her shopping cart and completing the order for that Product no later than 89 days after their initial click-through of the Special Link
facts.applies_to: Defines what a click-to-sale tracking record must record (campaigns page).

facts.topic: Cancelled, returned or refunded orders are disqualified
facts.quote: any Product order where a cancellation, return, or refund has been initiated,
facts.applies_to: Conversion counts must exclude these orders.

facts.topic: Original content and third-party material
facts.quote: Your Site(s) must contain original content and be publicly available via the website address provided in the application. Original content utilizing third-party materials must contain significant commentary, analysis, or transformation to any materials you include.
facts.applies_to: Content pages must add analysis, not only copy product data.

facts.topic: Creators API prerequisite
facts.quote: Have at least 10 qualifying sales within the past 30 days to access the PA API through the Creators API
facts.applies_to: Product, price and review data cannot be pulled automatically until this is met (FLG-006).

facts.topic: PA-API 5 is deprecated
facts.quote: The Amazon Product Advertising API 5.0 (PA-API 5) has been deprecated and is being replaced by the Creators API.
facts.applies_to: The site cites the Creators API as the data source (FLG-007).

facts.topic: ASIN definition (identifier length)
facts.quote: ASIN | Amazon Standard Identification Number: 10-Character alphanumeric unique identifier assigned by Amazon.
facts.section: Creators API GetItems, ItemIdType Parameter (chunk 1 of 3)
facts.applies_to: The three submitted identifiers are 9 characters, not 10-character ASINs (FLG-001). Confirms the 10-character statement in the executive summary.

facts.topic: FTC: disclose financial relationships
facts.quote: Disclose when you have any financial, employment, personal, or family relationship with a brand.
facts.applies_to: Disclosure is shown on every page and near the links (see PF-01).

facts.topic: FTC: disclosure must be hard to miss
facts.quote: Place it so it’s hard to miss.
facts.applies_to: Footer disclosure on each page; to be reviewed for placement (FLG-013).

facts.topic: FTC: no claims about products you have not tried
facts.quote: You can’t talk about your experience with a product you haven’t tried.
facts.applies_to: No first-hand product experience is claimed on this site.

facts.topic: Creators API: no data mining, robots or scraping
facts.quote: This license does not include any downloading, copying or other use of Program Content for the benefit of any third party, or any use of data mining, robots, or similar data gathering and extraction tools.
facts.section: Associates Program IP License and Usage Requirements, Section 1 (re-read 2026-11-13)
facts.applies_to: Automated collection of Amazon product data outside the Creators API is not permitted under this license.

facts.topic: Creators API: no AI analysis or aggregation without written approval
facts.quote: (e) You will not, without our express prior written approval, access or use Creators API, PA API or Data Feeds for the purpose of aggregating, analyzing, extracting, or repurposing any Product Advertising Content or in connection with any software or other application intended for use by persons or entities that offer products on an Amazon Site, or in the direct training or fine-tuning of a machine learning and/or foundational model.
facts.section: IP License and Usage Requirements, Section 2(c)(e) (re-read 2026-11-13)
facts.applies_to: An AI analysis layer on top of Creators API data needs express prior written approval (FLG-016).

facts.topic: Creators API: no ML models or LLMs built from Program Content
facts.quote: will not allow any third party to, use Program Content to, directly or indirectly, develop or improve large language or multimodal models, machine learning models or related technology.
facts.section: IP License and Usage Requirements, Section 1 (re-read 2026-11-13)
facts.applies_to: The platform may not use Program Content to train or improve models (FLG-016).

facts.topic: Participation Requirements: no ML models from Special Links or Program Content
facts.quote: You will not, without or express prior written approval, use, or allow any third party to use, any Special Links or Program Content to develop machine learning models or related technology.
facts.section: Associates Program Participation Requirements, Section 5 (re-read 2026-11-13; source text reads 'without or express')
facts.applies_to: Same constraint as PF-23/24, from the Participation Requirements (FLG-016).

facts.topic: Creators API: caching limits
facts.quote: Unless otherwise notified by us, you may store individual Amazon Standard Identification Numbers (ASINs) for an indefinite period until the termination of this License. ... if your application includes a client application, the client application may not store or cache Product Advertising Content.
facts.section: IP License and Usage Requirements, Section 2(h) (re-read 2026-11-13)
facts.applies_to: Non-image data may be cached for only 24 hours and must then be refreshed (FLG-019).

facts.topic: Creators API: date stamp and disclaimer for price or availability
facts.quote: You will include a date/time stamp adjacent to your display of pricing or availability information on your application if you obtain Product Advertising Content from Data Feeds, or if you call Creators API, PA API or refresh the Product Advertising Content displayed on your application less frequently than hourly.
facts.section: IP License and Usage Requirements, Section 2(i) (re-read 2026-11-13)
facts.applies_to: Any price or availability shown must carry a date and time and the disclaimer in 2(i) (FLG-019).

facts.topic: Creators API: text disclaimer
facts.quote: CERTAIN CONTENT THAT APPEARS [IN THIS APPLICATION or ON THIS SITE, as applicable] COMES FROM AMAZON. THIS CONTENT IS PROVIDED 'AS IS' AND IS SUBJECT TO CHANGE OR REMOVAL AT ANY TIME.
facts.section: IP License and Usage Requirements, Section 2(k) (re-read 2026-11-13)
facts.applies_to: Required plain-view disclaimer when Creators API text is displayed.

facts.topic: Creators API: rate limits and file size
facts.quote: you will not send files to or from Creators API or PA API that are greater than 40KB without our prior written approval.
facts.section: IP License and Usage Requirements, Section 2(j) (re-read 2026-11-13)
facts.applies_to: Limit on API calls and file size (FLG-019).

facts.topic: Creators API: credentials and Associates tag
facts.quote: You must use both a unique public key/private key pair (each key pair, an “Account Identifier”) and an Associates tag parameter
facts.section: IP License and Usage Requirements, Section 2(b) (re-read 2026-11-13)
facts.applies_to: Each API call needs an Associates tag and the account's own key pair (FLG-010).

facts.topic: Agents must identify themselves
facts.quote: In all HTTP/HTTPS requests, identify that the request is from an Agent and disclose the name of the Agent by including the following in the request’s user agent string
facts.applies_to: Any automated agent that accesses Program Content must identify itself (FLG-019).

facts.topic: Program Content only for Amazon products
facts.quote: You will not display on your Site, or otherwise use, any Program Content to advertise or promote any products that are offered on any site that is not an Amazon Site (e.g., products offered by other retailers).
facts.applies_to: Price or review comparisons with other retailers may not use Program Content (FLG-019).

facts.topic: No artificial clicks or sessions
facts.quote: You will not artificially generate clicks or impressions on your Site or create Sessions on an Amazon Site, whether by way of a robot or software program or otherwise.
facts.applies_to: Automated click generation is prohibited; click tracking must count real visits only.

facts.topic: No price tracking or alerting on the site
facts.quote: Unless otherwise agreed by Amazon, your Site must not have price tracking and/or price alerting functionality.
facts.applies_to: The platform may not offer price tracking or alerts without written agreement.

facts.topic: Schedule 1: Amazon Site by location (United States only)
facts.quote: SCHEDULE 1: AMAZON ENTITY AND AMAZON SITE BY LOCATION — United States | Amazon.com Services LLC | amazon.com
facts.applies_to: Schedule 1 lists only the United States site. Eligibility for an Oslo-based Associate is not stated in the text read (FLG-015).

facts.topic: Influencer Program example wording
facts.quote: (such as by using the text “#Ad” or “#Sponsored”)
facts.applies_to: Applies to the Influencer Program. The text is an example of a disclosure, not a requirement for this site.

facts.topic: FTC: current Endorsement Guides
facts.quote: revised in 2023
facts.section: FTC topic hub, Endorsements, Influencers, and Reviews (fetched 2026-11-13)
facts.applies_to: The 2019 brochure (PF-19 to PF-21) predates the 2023 revision. The current guides text was not read (FLG-017).

facts.topic: Category reference rate: Kitchen (Standard Commission)
facts.quote: Physical Books, Kitchen, Automotive | 4.50%
facts.applies_to: Applies only if a listing is in the Kitchen category. The product categories of the three listings are not verified (FLG-021).

facts.topic: Onsite Commission rates are for Onsite Content
facts.quote: We will pay you commission income (“Onsite Commission Income”) for Qualifying Purchases, which in the case of Onsite Commission Income is limited to Direct Qualifying Purchases.
facts.section: Onsite Associates Program Commission Income Statement, opening section (re-read 2026-11-13)
facts.applies_to: The Onsite rate table (Kitchen 1.25%) is not the rate for links on this site (FLG-021).

facts.topic: Application review: three qualifying sales in 180 days; personal orders excluded
facts.quote: After you sign up, our Associates team will check your application once you've driven qualified sales (we require at least three within the first 180 days). Please note that personal orders do not qualify. In our review, we check all of the Sites you've provided (websites, mobile apps, social network pages, and Alexa skills) to ensure that they meet our customer experience bar. All Sites must have robust original content (even when advertising is removed) - a good rule of thumb is at least 10 posts.
facts.applies_to: Campaign ramp planning: a new account must drive at least three qualifying external sales within 180 days and carry substantial original content. Added by session 33226b37-zone3.

facts.topic: Account dormancy: 180 days to refer a sale
facts.quote: Once you've applied, you have 180 days to refer a sale through one of your Associates links. ... Your application can be withdrawn if there were not enough qualifying sales for 180 days after your application was submitted.
facts.applies_to: New-account survival gate, consistent with PF-40. Added by session 33226b37-zone3.

facts.topic: Payment timing: approximately 60 days after month end
facts.quote: We will pay Standard Commission Income and Special Commission Income in the default currency for an Amazon Site approximately 60 days following the end of each calendar month in which they were earned by the method described below that you have selected.
facts.section: Associates Program Commission Income Statement, Section 6 (Commission Income Reporting and Payment) (read 2026-11-13)
facts.applies_to: Cash-flow planning: commissions lag the calendar month by roughly two months. Added by session 33226b37-zone3.

facts.topic: Payment minimums (US): deposit $10, gift card $10, check $100
facts.quote: Option 1 (Deposit) 10 USD ... Option 2 (Gift Card) 10 USD 2000 USD ... Option 3 (Check) 100 USD ... Check Processing Fee 15 USD.
facts.section: Associates Program Commission Income Statement, Section 6, Payment Minimum Chart (read 2026-11-13)
facts.applies_to: Payout-method planning. Added by session 33226b37-zone3.

facts.quote: Product prices and availability may vary from time to time. ... your Site may only show prices and availability if: (a) we serve the link in which that price and availability data are displayed, or (b) you obtain Product pricing and availability data via Creators API or PA API ...
facts.applies_to: Price and availability display. See FLG-022.

facts.applies_to: Rating and review display. See FLG-022.

facts.applies_to: Short links and link labels. See FLG-024.

facts.section: Creators API documentation, Introduction, Prerequisites item 2 (read 2026-11-14)

facts.topic: Affiliate disclosure must be clear and conspicuous, placed close to the recommendation
facts.quote: You should disclose your relationship to the retailer clearly and conspicuously on your site, so readers can decide how much weight to give your endorsement. ... The closer the disclosure is to your recommendation, the better.
facts.section: FTC Endorsement Guides FAQ, section 'What About Affiliate or Network Marketing?' (read 2026-11-14)
facts.applies_to: Disclosure placement. See FLG-017.

facts.topic: 'Affiliate link' or a 'buy now' button alone is not an adequate disclosure
facts.quote: Consumers might not understand that 'affiliate link' means that the person placing the link is getting paid for purchases made through the link. Similarly, a 'buy now' button would not be adequate.
facts.section: FTC Endorsement Guides FAQ, section 'What About Affiliate or Network Marketing?' (read 2026-11-14)
facts.applies_to: Disclosure wording.
